== Expansion, 25 October 2026 ==
'''Build notes.''' Added the Star Wars roles, the Likeness on SWCCG cards section ([[Lieutenant Sheckil]], [[Human Shield]]) and Lore wordplay. Same likeness pattern as [[Michonne Bourriague]] / [[Aurra Sing]]: <code>likeness</code> and <code>notes</code> on both card pages. Sources: StarWars.com and BBC obituaries, Wookieepedia (Jeremy Bulloch, Sheckil, Sheckil/Legends), each with an opened Wayback capture. The lore and game text quotes match the card scans and swccg-card-json.

'''Corrected data.''' Sheckil's scenes are in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), not ''Return of the Jedi''; StarWars.com and Wookieepedia agree.

'''Missing data.'''
* No Decipher designer comment or article saying the Sheckil lore was meant as a joke about Bulloch was found. The page attributes the "tongue-in-cheek" reading to Wookieepedia only.
* [[Ambush]] (Cloud City) also shows Sheckil's face in its image. [[Human Shield (Original)]] and [[Human Shield (PC Errata)]] use the same still. None of them has a <code>likeness</code> line yet.
* Boba Fett cards ([[Boba Fett (Cloud City)]], [[Boba Fett (Special Edition)]] and others) are not listed as his likeness. Fett's face is never seen, and other performers wore the suit in some shots, so each image would need checking against its film scene.
* The 2004 Hidalgo set-diary quote is cited through Wookieepedia. The Hyperspace page was members-only.

'''Marginal cuts.''' None. The DecipherCon 1999 text, photographs and refs are kept as written.
